verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing a hosted email service's code is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no Fastmail source code released under an open license. JMAP being an open, patent-free standard is an adjacent openness feature, not the product's source, and the 'Open source and standards' item is only a page title with no content about licensed code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
